scientific_question: W-R17 detects large permutations under real jitter; does a train-only learned order threshold recognize an unseen single adjacent-tail swap, or does it exploit large permutation magnitude?
preregistration: Freeze all source generation, threshold rules, controls, cohort and success thresholds before first-use scientific execution. Never tune based on heldout scores.
population: Same exact frozen W-R11 16x4 original sequence; nine entities/seed, 16 ticks; candidate global channel offsets +17 development and +61 heldout, then deterministic per-tick nuisance.
noise: Development per-tick signed jitter ((5*t+seed+entity)%3)-1; heldout ((7*t+seed+entity)%5)-2. Assert exactly three/five distinct levels in 16 ticks.
positives: Candidate preserves shifted+jittered sequence order. Negative preserves candidate first row and exact unordered multiset. For development negative: reverse tail if entity even, rotate tail left 3 if odd. For heldout negative only: swap adjacent tail positions index7 and 8 (zero-based sequence indices, avoiding fixed anchor).
equal_capacity_arms: unordered histogram L1 difference after anchor correction, one train-only threshold
mean circular anchor-relative position mismatch, one train-only threshold
maximum circular anchor-relative per-position mismatch, one train-only threshold
maximum adjacent transition discrepancy between reference and candidate first-channel circular differences, one train-only threshold
learning: For each scalar feature, calculate max score across 36 development positives and min score across 36 development negatives, freeze threshold midpoint. Predict positive if feature <= threshold. No heldout class data, training iteration, post-hoc model selection or extra capacity.
metrics: For all 4 arms, record exact train ranges, thresholds, per-seed heldout TP/TN/FP/FN, accuracy and false-positive counts.
classification: LOCAL_ORDER_TRANSFER if transition arm >=0.85 accuracy and unordered <=0.55; PARTIAL if transition beats both pooled and unordered but below 0.85; otherwise NEGATIVE. Invalid if invariants or source identity fail.
validity: Candidate set matching per positive/negative pair; genuine nondegenerate noise; distinct heldout generator; source blobs pin exact W-R17 and W-R11; deterministic first-use archive; one full Wingless regression.
claim_limit: A bounded toy test of local sequence order; not generic language or perception intelligence; no accepted-ref mutation.
